heuristics.statement: For a uniform 256-bit seed S, the 256 16-bit prefixes of SHA-256('HS-BATCH-v1' || S || uint16le(j)), j=0..255, have a repeated value with probability at least 0.39. The iid-uniform birthday model motivates this concrete population claim but is not an identity for fixed SHA-256.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the submitted single-batch sampler, fixed full SHA-256 seed expansion, 256 counters, 16-bit prefix, uniform 256-bit algorithmic seed, and complete eight-step MD5 target.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 256 reproducible organizer-selected seeds to the probability over all 2^256 seeds; no larger batch, longer MD5 prefix, or full MD5 extrapolation.
heuristics.limitations: Finite checked collisions support the sampler but do not establish uniformity, independence, or a population lower bound of 0.39. Public seeds are not a blinded holdout; no confidence interval or measured runtime is asserted as a proof.
